nodes.summary: A group $G$ is locally finite when every finite subset $S \subseteq G$ generates a finite subgroup; equivalently, every finitely generated subgroup of $G$ is finite.
nodes.title: Locally finite group, via finite subsets

nodes.summary: A subset $D$ of a group $G$ is a set of 3-transpositions when it is closed under conjugation ($g d g^{-1} \in D$ for all $g \in G$ and $d \in D$), every $d \in D$ is an involution ($d \ne 1$ and $d^2 = 1$), and for all $d, e \in D$ the product $de$ has order at most $3$, that is, $de = 1$, $(de)^2 = 1$ or $(de)^3 = 1$.
nodes.title: Set of 3-transpositions

nodes.summary: If a group $G$ is generated by a set $D$ of 3-transpositions (a conjugation-invariant set of involutions whose pairwise products have order at most $3$), then $G$ is locally finite: every finite subset of $G$ generates a finite subgroup of $G$.
nodes.title: Groups generated by 3-transpositions are locally finite

nodes.summary: The statement that for every group $G$ and every set $D$ of 3-transpositions of $G$ that generates $G$, the group $G$ is locally finite.
nodes.title: Sozutov's question on 3-transposition groups (Kourovka 12.76)

can_state.label: ready to state

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
